svg.title: The values a forecast passes through, and the leak each one closes
svg.desc: Six steps from top to bottom. The row reader produces ObservedRow values, each with what the row measures, which closes a split or a score decided from a row's label; this is held by a convention. The fit builds a TrainingPartition, a row count and a digest per stream, which closes a row that is both trained and held out; this is held by the type. The fit writes the partition to fit.meta.json and a later command reads it back against the data, which closes a later step cutting the data differently and a fitted row edited after the fit; this is a run-time check. ForecastPlan takes its origin from the partition and lists the targets, which closes an origin anywhere but the end of the training rows; this is held by the type. The forecast driver runs a particle filter over the training rows and builds the StateConditioning, which closes a held-out row moving the state at the origin; this is a run-time check and a type. camdl score binds the outcome rows, which closes outcomes taken from another series and a score that changes the forecast; these are run-time checks.
svg.text: VALUE
THE LEAK IT CLOSES, AND WHAT HOLDS IT
ObservedRow
a data row and what it measures
a split or a score decided from a row's label
convention: one function states the cutoff rule
TrainingPartition
per stream, a row count and a digest
a row both trained and held out; a gap in training
type: membership is a position below the count
fit.meta.json
the partition, read back on the data
a later step cutting differently; an edited fitted row
run-time check: the digest of the leading rows
ForecastPlan, Target
the origin and what is predicted
an origin that is not the end of the training rows
type: the constructor takes no origin
StateConditioning
the rows the filter was given
a held-out row moving the state at the origin
run-time check, and a cell type the filter skips
camdl score
outcome rows bound to targets
outcomes from another series; a changed forecast
run-time checks: row digests, and a byte comparison
